objective: Build all twelve designs and determine which are suitable for thin-tip precision grasping with reliable contact and normal-force feedback through 20 N per finger.
previous_goal_turn_classification: progress: twelve-design publication completed and verified
evidence_scope: Published source, recorded campaign state and supplied publication verification; no lab-storage or hardware discovery is inferred.

requirements.requirement: Separate design pages, CAD, BOMs, code, documentation and visuals
requirements.scope_limit: Delivered design files do not prove that the parts have been fabricated or assembled.

requirements.requirement: Build all twelve designs with three independent specimens each
requirements.needed: Dated assembly records, material/component identities, actual fit checks and specimen photographs.

requirements.requirement: Reliable contact at 0.2 N and false-contact probability <=1%
requirements.needed: Raw independent labelled presentations, frozen thresholds, held-out outcomes and per-condition confidence bounds.

requirements.requirement: Force feedback through 20 N per finger
requirements.needed: Calibrated force reference, complete loading/unloading and mixed-contact coverage, held-out errors and unavailable readings.

requirements.requirement: Thin-tip access, added motion, recovery and precision tasks
requirements.needed: Measured installed thickness/opening loss, reference-relative tip motion and fixed-protocol task trials.

requirements.requirement: Interference, drift, long holds, wear and replacement
requirements.needed: Identified no-contact motion/pose/cable/temperature conditions, repeated-load and surface-replacement records.
Complete physical gates plus actual assembly/rework/calibration time and failed-build counts. Do not rank missing measurements.

required_test_categories: part identity, power, raw acquisition and fault behavior
installed fit and preservation of leading-tip access
held-out loading/unloading at different contact positions and contact areas
zero return, hysteresis, drift and long holds
no-contact jaw/motor motion and gravity poses
steel proximity, cable movement and temperature changes
repeated loading, surface wear and replacement
timed independent assembly, rework, calibration and replacement
representative precision tasks using a fixed task protocol
next_required_action: Assign the student/operator, fabricate and assemble identified specimens, and record physical measurements using the published protocols.
blocking_dependency: Physical fabrication/assembly and test evidence are not available in the reported campaign.
